name: Marcin Dudek
biography: Marcin Dudek leads CERT Polska, Poland’s national CERT. Before taking on this role, he spent more than a decade in hands-on technical work across OT security, incident response, and APT investigations. His background includes industrial control systems security in critical infrastructure environments, including Poland’s only research nuclear reactor, as well as analysis of APT activity targeting Poland. He regularly speaks at local and international cybersecurity conferences and was deeply involved in the response to the incident described in this talk.

endorsements.name: Marcin Dudek
